title: 说说建大K925 28c和马牌gsr 28c的参数
notes: Owner post (edited 2026-05-14): six K925 tires (two 25C, four 28C) for CNY 340 delivered; 28C about 255 g, about 70 g lighter than a Continental Grand Sport Race 28C; 29.4 mm wide on a 23 mm internal rim against the GSR's 31.4 mm; light, low rolling resistance, easy to fit by hand; described as a dry paved-road training tire.
